verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for an AI assistant app with agent features, but the evidence never shows user-defined rules, triggers, or event hooks. Autonomous agents that act via chat platforms (jan-docs-14) and autonomous task execution (jan-docs-13) are agent capabilities, not configurable event-to-action rules. The per-project default assistant (jan-docs-12) is a static setting, not an event trigger.
